tok.description: Tok DOI record id, e.g. tok:pie:0001

base_doi.description: DOI of the canonical Proclamation being endorsed

signatory.description: Name or handle. Pseudonyms permitted. May be empty for anonymous.

statement.description: The endorsement statement that was hashed (verbatim).

ots_ayesha.description: AyeSHA-encoded OpenTimestamps proof of statement_sha256. Raw .ots is NOT stored.

artifact_url.description: Optional pointer to where the signatory stored their own copy. Not the OTS.
